title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.0.11
description:
• 📋 1-Click Copy for Google Sheets: Copies results (UID, Suspend, Error) line-by-line in exact order for instant vertical Ctrl+V pasting next to numbers.
• 🎯 True Error Reporting: Differentiates real suspensions from network errors, OTP timeouts, or captcha issues (no false 'Suspend' labels).
• 👤 Exact Gender Selection & 2-Stage SMS Resend Flow.
